title: RPP
description: RPP is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that gives every player a unique path when they join your server. Each path provides its own special playstyle and small advantages, making every player feel different without breaking the game.
body:
RPP – Random Player Paths

RPP is a lightweight plugin that gives every player a unique path when they join the server. Each path represents a different playstyle and identity, making SMP worlds more fun and diverse without adding complicated mechanics.

✨ Features

🎲 Automatic Path Assignment: Players receive a random path the moment they join.

🌱 About 10 Unique Paths: Every player becomes different, giving your server personality.

⚖️ Balanced & Simple: Paths are designed to be fun, not overpowered.

🧪 Lightweight: Small, fast, and optimized — perfect for SMPs.
